bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $151.5 转折点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 6.1% on Oct 14 to $147.55 and is down 17% in five sessions; with 68 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its 5-day ($161.3), 10-day ($175.1) and 30-day ($180.6) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($191.3), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月14日下跌 6.1%，收于 $147.55，五个交易日下跌 17%；上市仅 68 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于 5 日（$161.3）、10 日（$175.1）和 30 日均线（$180.6）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$191.3），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The $151.5 Aug 24 pivot broke and is now first resistance, then $160–161 (July pivot, 5-day average) and $175 (10-day). The day's low of $147.13 is just above the $145.6 Jul 17 pivot; below it are $133.8 (Aug 7 low) and the $124.80 July low. A close below $145.6 would open $133.8. Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: $151.5 的 8月24日转折点失守，现为第一阻力，其次 $160–161（7月转折点、5 日均线）和 $175（10 日均线）。当日低点 $147.13 略高于 $145.6 的 7月17日转折点；其下为 $133.8（8月7日低点）和 $124.80 的 7月低点。若收盘跌破 $145.6，下一目标看 $133.8。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

s.en: July low, floor of its history

bias.zh: 偏空 · 收于 200 日均线下方

read.en: SK hynix fell 1.7% in Seoul on Oct 14 to ₩1,419,000 after an intraday high of ₩1,497,000 and is down 20% in five sessions. It closed below its 200-day average (₩1,449,555), its falling 5, 10 and 30-day averages (₩1.57–1.73 million) and the 100-day (₩1.93 million). MACD is below its signal and zero line, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28, and RSI is 31.
read.zh: SK 海力士 10月14日在首尔盘中触及 ₩1,497,000 后回落，下跌 1.7%，收于 ₩1,419,000，五个交易日下跌 20%。股价收于 200 日均线（₩1,449,555）、下行的 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线（₩157万–173万）及 100 日均线（₩193万）下方。MACD 位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空，RSI 为 31。

read.en: The intraday rebound failed at ₩1,497,000 and the stock closed below the 200-day zone (₩1.44–1.45 million), which is now first resistance, then ₩1,497,000 and ₩1.56–1.57 million (Sep 2 low, 5-day average). Support is the Oct 14 low of ₩1,402,000, then the Aug 10 low of ₩1,373,000 and the Jul 28 low of ₩1,246,000. A close below ₩1,373,000 would open ₩1,246,000.
